content: pg_dump-only backup strategies leave gaps: dumps can complete without error yet miss tables (permission issues), restores can fail against a different Postgres version, and backups are frequently never restore-tested until a real incident. Best practice: automate dumps (cron/systemd timer + off-box storage), monitor/alert on backup job failure, and schedule periodic actual restore drills (e.g., monthly) rather than trusting an untested dump.
